title: Ex-MILF military chief elected first BARMM Chief Minister

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Member of Parliament (MP) Abdulraof “Sammy Gambar” Macacua was elected the first Chief Minister of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) on Friday during the regional legislature’s inaugural session at the Shariff Kabunsuan Cultural Center. Macacua, who heads the Bangsamoro Federalist Party, was nominated by MP Kitem Kadatuan, and was in contention for the post with MP Ahod “Al Haj Murad” Ebrahim, who was nominated by MP Mohagher Iqbal. After votes were counted, Macacua gained the support of 51 MPs, while Ebrahim, representing the United Bangsamoro Justice Party, gathered 27.
